(i) Sturm gives SUFFICIENT seating only. The class name 'Sturm-universal' already says that, so (i) is inside. (ii) The threshold is fed u where the theorem needs T_kk, and the two are equal only for pressureless matter along the ray. The grade also computes that the stretch may be the diameter, which gives a ratio of pi^2/6 instead of 2 pi^2/3. S-2's class is defined through H_ball, which fixes a uniform energy density u and says nothing about pressure. So the class contains balls with T_kk = (1+w)u > u along the ray. For those, Sturm-certified seating on a chord of length s needs u >= pi c^4/(4 G (1+w) s^2), and u_seat/u_collapse = (2 pi^2/3)/((1+w)(s/l)^2). Restricted to what the grade says holds (T_kk = u), S-2 stays EMPTY for both stretches: computed through specthm, the ratio is 6.580 on the radius and 1.645 on the diameter. A magnetised ball probed across B (T_kk = 2u, the grade's own rederive [7]) or a stiff fluid gives pi^2/12 = 0.8225, and both respect the dominant energy condition. I set spec.seat_over_collapse to that value using specthm's own control mechanism, patched(). Restricting the z3 fact directly to Implies(And(ball, Tkk_eq_u_along_ray), bh) also sends S-2 EMPTY -> OPEN (main and route). Buchdahl's tighter collapse bound does not rescue it (0.8225 x 9/8 = 0.925 < 1). What would keep S-2 EMPTY is a named hypothesis that H_ball lacks: T_kk = u along the seating ray (pressureless), or quantitatively (T_kk/u)(s/l)^2 < 2 pi^2/3. Radiation on the diameter (w = 1/3, ratio 1.234) and any DEC-respecting matter on the radius (ratio >= 3.29) stay EMPTY. No ledger row moves, since SR2 is not a ledger row. The audit's statement 'No verdict of the tree is overturned' evaluated the T_kk/u drift only on the withdrawn magnetic B*l text, and the diameter only at T_kk = u.
